fields.description:
Two cheap, decoupled wins split out of the `doctor`/`fsck`/`validate` consolidation. The
consolidation itself is already tracked on epic `dabb-7d4b-f5bc-40e6` and is NOT duplicated here.

**1. `validate --fix` is advertised in three places and does nothing.** `validate.py:361-362` is
literally `elif arg == "--fix": pass  # accepted, no-op (the bash --fix path is unimplemented)`.
It is documented in `--help` (`validate.py:342`), in `docs/cli-reference.md:458`, AND printed at
runtime as the suggested remedy (`validate.py:309`, `:322`: "Run with `--fix` to attempt automatic
repairs (interactive)"). A user following the tool's own advice gets nothing, silently.

Maintainer decision: remove it. `doctor` is the path for fixing.

**2. `docs/chatgpt-agent-guide.md:91` sends agents to the wrong command.** It says to run
"`rebar validate` (or `rebar fsck`) against the tracker to confirm store integrity" — but store
integrity is `fsck`'s job and is not something `validate` checks at all. `fsck` reads bytes and git
refs; `validate` reads reduced ticket semantics. They are cleanly disjoint.

Investigation confirmed the ambiguity has already cost real work: two epics (`dabb` and
`18ae-4f54-a85b-4ddb`) were independently filed scoping the same `doctor` command, and `18ae` was
closed as a duplicate.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] `--fix` is removed from `validate`'s parser, `--help`, `docs/cli-reference.md`, and both runtime hints
- [x] `docs/chatgpt-agent-guide.md:91` names the correct command for store integrity
- [x] Epic `dabb-7d4b-f5bc-40e6` is updated with this audit's findings (capability matrix, the no-op, the usage evidence that `doctor` is invoked by nothing)

## CORRECTION (plan-review BLOCK, criterion G1G2) — the edit set was under-enumerated

"Advertised in three places" was wrong. Verified against the tree, `--fix` is advertised at FOUR
independent sites, plus the two runtime hints:

1. `src/rebar/_cli/help/validate.txt:1` — the `--help` usage line (the SOURCE of the generated doc)
2. `src/rebar/_cli/help/overview.txt:23` — the `rebar` overview listing
3. `README.md:370` — the flag list in the validate paragraph
4. `docs/cli-reference.md:458` — GENERATED from the help text; must be REGENERATED
   (`python scripts/gen_cli_reference.py`), never hand-edited, or the CI drift gate rejects it
5. `validate.py:309` and `:322` — the runtime "Run with `--fix` to attempt automatic repairs
   (interactive)" hints
6. `validate.py:361-362` — the parser arm itself (`elif arg == "--fix": pass`)

`README.md` is additionally covered by `scripts/check_readme_quickstart.py`, so the README edit
must keep that gate green.

## Acceptance Criteria (supersedes the list above)

- [x] `--fix` is removed from `validate`'s parser (`validate.py:361-362`)
- [x] `--fix` is removed from ALL FOUR advertisement sites: `_cli/help/validate.txt`,
      `_cli/help/overview.txt`, `README.md`, and `docs/cli-reference.md` (the last REGENERATED via
      `scripts/gen_cli_reference.py`, with `--check` clean)
- [x] Both runtime hints (`validate.py:309`, `:322`) no longer suggest `--fix`; they point at
      `doctor`, which is the path for fixing
- [x] Passing `--fix` is REFUSED rather than silently accepted, via validate's existing
      unknown-option fall-through: stderr `Unknown option: --fix` and **exit 1**
- [x] `scripts/check_readme_quickstart.py` and `scripts/gen_cli_reference.py --check` both pass
- [x] `docs/chatgpt-agent-guide.md:91` names `fsck` (store integrity), not `validate`
- [x] Epic `dabb-7d4b-f5bc-40e6` is updated with this audit's findings (capability matrix, the
      no-op, the usage evidence that `doctor` is invoked by nothing)


## CORRECTION 3 (plan-review BLOCK, criteria E4/G6) — the exit code was wrong

Correction 2 above asserted `--fix` would be refused with "exit 2, unknown option". That is
mechanically wrong and was my error, not the ticket's. Verified empirically:

    $ rebar validate --bogus-option ; echo $?
    Unknown option: --bogus-option
    1

`_engine_support/validate.py`'s unknown-argument fall-through (the `else` arm) prints
`Unknown option: ...` and returns **1**. Exit 2 comes only from the `--output` parser
(`OutputFormatError`), which `--fix` never reaches. Deleting the `elif arg == "--fix": pass`
arm therefore yields exit 1 from the existing else-branch — no new code is needed to refuse it,
and no exit-code change should be attempted as part of this ticket.


## CORRECTION 4 (plan-review BLOCK, criteria G1G2) — the in-file `_HELP` string

Corrections 1-3 still missed the `_HELP` literal INSIDE `_engine_support/validate.py`, which
advertises `--fix` at two lines. Verified:

    validate.py:337  _HELP = """Usage: rebar validate [--quick] [--full] [--fix] ...
    validate.py:342    --fix          Attempt to automatically fix issues (interactive)

That is a SIXTH advertisement site (distinct from `_cli/help/validate.txt`, which is the packaged
help text). The complete removal set is therefore:

1. `_engine_support/validate.py:337` — `_HELP` usage line
2. `_engine_support/validate.py:342` — `_HELP` option description
3. `_engine_support/validate.py:309`, `:322` — the two runtime "Run with `--fix`" hints
4. `_engine_support/validate.py:361-362` — the parser arm itself
5. `_cli/help/validate.txt:1` — packaged help usage line
6. `_cli/help/overview.txt:23` — overview listing
7. `README.md:370` — flag list
8. `docs/cli-reference.md:458` — GENERATED; regenerate, never hand-edit

The lesson for the implementer: `grep -rn -- '--fix'` across `src/ docs/ README.md` is the check,
not a curated list. The final AC below requires exactly that grep to come back clean.

## Acceptance Criteria (FINAL — supersedes all lists above)

- [x] `grep -rn -- '--fix' src/rebar/_engine_support/validate.py src/rebar/_cli/help/ README.md
      docs/cli-reference.md` returns NO advertisement of a validate `--fix` flag
- [x] The parser arm is deleted, so `--fix` falls through to the existing unknown-option handler:
      stderr `Unknown option: --fix`, **exit 1** (NOT exit 2 — exit 2 comes only from the
      `--output` parser, which `--fix` never reaches)
- [x] Both runtime hints point at `doctor`, which is the path for fixing
- [x] `docs/cli-reference.md` is REGENERATED (`scripts/gen_cli_reference.py`), `--check` clean
- [x] `scripts/check_readme_quickstart.py` passes
- [x] `docs/chatgpt-agent-guide.md:91` names `fsck` for store integrity, not `validate`
- [x] Epic `dabb-7d4b-f5bc-40e6` is updated with this audit's findings
